papers.title: When Do Rankings Beat Signs? Gradient Direction Recovery under Even Nuisance
papers.translated_title: 排名何时胜过符号？均匀干扰下的梯度方向恢复
papers.author: Zhuangzhuang Pan
papers.summary: Can ranking a batch of antipodal query pairs recover a gradient direction with fewer evaluations than using within-pair signs alone? We study fixed-center recovery in $d$ dimensions for a linear signal plus an unknown differentiable even nuisance, counting function evaluations and feedback rounds separately. Shared pair offsets create an information hierarchy: Mirror retains within-pair signs, Reverse couples reversed cross-pair orders to cancel offsets, and Full enforces all ranking inequalities. Relative shell variation is the nuisance range over the query sphere normalized by the linear-signal scale. When it is at most $c\varepsilon/\sqrt{d}$, Reverse localizes every consistent direction to angular accuracy $\varepsilon$ using $\widetilde{O}(d+\sqrt{d/\varepsilon})$ evaluations in one round at fixed confidence, without a variation bound supplied to the decoder. This matches a lower bound up to logarithmic factors, versus the $Θ(d/\varepsilon)$ one-round sign-only minimax cost on the same class. Over well-conditioned positive-definite quadratics with no common relative-curvature bound, the $R$-round minimax cost is instead $Θ(dR(\varepsilon^{-1/R}-1))$, even with cumulative rankings. We extend validity beyond exact evenness under supplied error bounds. Matched-endpoint experiments certify information beyond signs and short cycles. On two ridge tasks under joint evaluation and round caps, short-cycle recovery attains lower terminal mean gaps than the tested batch-capable controls. An additional optimization benefit from fitting the complete ranking remains unestablished.
papers.translated_summary: 将一批对跖查询对进行排序，能否比仅使用对内符号以更少的评估次数恢复梯度方向？我们研究 $d$ 维中固定中心恢复问题，信号为线性信号加上未知的可微偶扰动，分别统计函数评估次数和反馈轮数。共享的对偏移形成信息层级：Mirror 保留对内符号，Reverse 将反转的跨对顺序耦合以抵消偏移，Full 则强制所有排序不等式。相对壳层变化是查询球面上扰动范围按线性信号尺度归一化后的量。当其至多为 $c\varepsilon/\sqrt{d}$ 时，Reverse 在固定置信度下用一轮 $\widetilde{O}(d+\sqrt{d/\varepsilon})$ 次评估将每个一致方向定位到角度精度 $\varepsilon$，且解码器无需提供变化界。这与下界在对数因子内匹配，而同一类上一轮仅符号的极小极大代价为 $Θ(d/\varepsilon)$。对于良态正定二次型且无公共相对曲率界的情形，$R$ 轮极小极大代价则为 $Θ(dR(\varepsilon^{-1/R}-1))$，即使使用累积排序亦然。我们在给定误差界下将有效性推广到超出精确偶性的情形。匹配端点实验证实了符号之外的信息以及短环。在两个联合评估与轮数上限下的 ridge 任务中，短环恢复比所测试的具备批处理能力的对照方法获得更低的终端平均间隙。拟合完整排序带来的额外优化收益仍未确立。

papers.title: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
papers.translated_title: 无参考人形机器人滑板通过终止塑形强化学习
papers.author: Ganeshvar Soenessardien
papers.summary: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. The method combines task rewards with exploit-blocking terminations. We introduce a number of constraints restricting behaviours such as losing the planted board foot, standing with both feet on the board, excessive twisting, separation from the board, and unstable board motion. Their changing prevalence during training produces an implicit progression from stance control towards sustained robot--board locomotion.
papers.translated_summary: 人形机器人运动研究在行走和奔跑方面已取得快速进展，但物体介导的运动——即机器人必须与被动外部物体协调身体——仍然困难。一项具有挑战性的任务是滑板，它要求同时与地面以及一个被动但可移动的平台交互以实现前进运动。当前用人形机器人应对滑板任务的方法要么需要人类演示，要么采用需要系统辨识的解析转向模型。本文中，我们提出一个深度强化学习框架，该框架不依赖演示等先验数据，并使K1人形机器人等机器人能够使用无模型学习学会滑板。该方法将任务奖励与阻止利用的终止条件相结合。我们引入了若干限制特定行为的约束，例如失去踩板脚、双脚站在板上、过度扭转、与板分离以及板运动不稳定。这些约束在训练过程中流行度的变化，产生了从站立控制到持续机器人—板运动的隐式渐进。

papers.title: Studying AI Act Mentions: A first look at the impact of the European Union's AI regulation on Hugging Face
papers.translated_title: 研究《人工智能法案》提及情况：欧盟人工智能监管对Hugging Face影响的初步观察
papers.author: Anamaria Mojica-Hanke
papers.summary: The European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) entered into force in August 2024, and its obligations apply in stages. Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models have applied since August 2025, and transparency rules since August 2026. These obligations affect developers who share and deploy models and applications on public platforms such as Hugging Face (HF), the largest platform for distributing AI artifacts. However, little is known about how practitioners respond to the regulation in practice. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical study of explicit references to the AI Act on HF. We collected over five million records, including repository cards, discussions, and commits from Models, Datasets, and Spaces, and identified over 1,500 records that explicitly mention the Act. Two coders manually labeled these records using a primarily closed coding approach, and we analyzed the resulting categories per source. We find that explicit references to the AI Act remain rare across all repository types. Repository cards mainly contain claims of compliance and responsibility, like ensuring compliance or assigning responsibility to downstream users, and some claim that the Act does not apply because the model is not a general-purpose AI model. Discussions are used to report alleged violations of the Act, while commits mainly update artifacts that support compliance. Overall, compliance statements focus on who is responsible rather than how compliance is achieved. We believe that this calls for direct platform support, e.g., automated checks and documentation templates, as well as clearer guidance on the scope of the AI Act.
papers.translated_summary: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）于2024年8月生效，其义务分阶段适用。通用人工智能模型提供者的义务自2025年8月起适用，透明度规则自2026年8月起适用。这些义务影响在Hugging Face（HF）等公共平台上共享和部署模型与应用的开发者，HF是分发人工智能制品最大的平台。然而，实践者如何在实践中回应这一监管，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对HF上明确提及《人工智能法案》的情况进行了实证研究。我们收集了超过五百万条记录，包括来自模型、数据集和空间（Spaces）的仓库卡片、讨论和提交，并识别出超过1500条明确提及该法案的记录。两名编码者采用以封闭式编码为主的方法对这些记录进行了人工标注，我们按来源分析了由此产生的类别。我们发现，明确提及《人工智能法案》的情况在所有仓库类型中仍然罕见。仓库卡片主要包含合规与责任声明，如确保合规或将责任分配给下游用户，还有一些声称该法案不适用，因为该模型不是通用人工智能模型。讨论被用于报告涉嫌违反该法案的行为，而提交主要更新支持合规的制品。总体而言，合规声明侧重于由谁负责，而非如何实现合规。我们认为，这需要平台提供直接支持，例如自动化检查和文档模板，以及就《人工智能法案》的适用范围提供更清晰的指引。

papers.title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
papers.translated_title: PaveSplat：具有残差校正表面对齐协方差的分辨率鲁棒前馈高斯泼溅
papers.author: Janghun Kim
papers.summary: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出PaveSplat，一种前馈高斯泼溅方法，它在解析的面向表面对齐协方差上添加学习到的残差，使面元在跨渲染分辨率时始终铺满可见表面。像素对齐的前馈高斯泼溅从少量图像中单次预测每个像素一个基元，其渲染质量取决于这些基元对表面的覆盖程度。近期基于面元的方法从预测深度解析计算面向表面对齐协方差。然而，当深度导出的坐标系病态时，该协方差无法校正面元朝向。于是面元松散地覆盖表面；在训练分辨率下，每个面元的一像素最小足迹覆盖了间隙，但当同一预测在更高分辨率下重新渲染时，这些间隙会表现为空洞。为解决此问题，我们保留解析协方差作为初始化，其轴对齐到表面切向，并添加一个初始化为单位四元数的残差，仅在能改善渲染时重新定向面元，将解析坐标系瞄准错误的面元转回表面。在RealEstate10K上，PaveSplat在每一尺度（1x-8x）下于每像素单高斯方法中取得最佳PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS。原生分辨率下的增益较小；当同一预测在不重新运行网络的情况下以更高显示分辨率渲染时，优势显现。在零样本DL3DV上，它在该组内每一尺度下领先PSNR，并在SSIM/LPIPS上排名第一或第二。覆盖空洞分析表明，在高分辨率重渲染下，其未覆盖像素少于两个基线。

papers.title: Streaming-AAA: Streaming AAA Game Video Generation at High Resolution, High Frame Rate, and Low Latency
papers.translated_title: 流式AAA：高分辨率、高帧率、低延迟的流式AAA游戏视频生成
papers.author: Zhihao Hu
papers.summary: Controllable streaming video generation offers a promising route toward interactive game simulation, yet existing methods remain far from practical gameplay. They often fail to jointly achieve high visual fidelity, high frame rates, and low interaction latency, resulting in poor responsiveness and degraded user experience. We present Streaming-AAA, a new paradigm for controllable infinite generation of AAA-quality game videos. Our system generates 1080p gameplay videos at 43 FPS with 198 ms end-to-end latency interaction on merely NVIDIA A800 GPUs, while supporting long-horizon play without severe temporal degradation or collapse. Streaming-AAA is built upon three key designs. First, we redesign the VAE architecture for efficient high-resolution decoding, enabling real-time synthesis at 1080p. Second, we pretrain the diffusion model using diffusion forcing and significantly extend the temporal training horizon, allowing the model to capture long-term dependencies and maintain persistent memory. Third, we perform post-training distillation and memory compression to improve inference efficiency while retaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Experiments show that Streaming-AAA substantially improves visual fidelity, frame rate, latency, and long-term stability over prior controllable video generation approaches, enabling a significantly more playable experience for interactive AAA game video generation.
papers.translated_summary: 可控流式视频生成在交互式游戏仿真方面展现出广阔前景，然而现有方法仍远未达到实用游戏化的要求。这些方法往往无法同时实现高视觉保真度、高帧率和低交互延迟，导致响应性差、用户体验下降。我们提出Streaming-AAA，这是一种用于可控无限生成AAA级游戏视频的新范式。我们的系统在仅使用NVIDIA A800 GPU的情况下，以43 FPS生成1080p游戏视频，端到端交互延迟为198毫秒，同时支持长时间游玩而不会出现严重的时间退化或崩溃。Streaming-AAA基于三项关键设计构建。第一，我们重新设计了VAE架构以实现高效的高分辨率解码，从而支持1080p的实时合成。第二，我们使用扩散强制（diffusion forcing）预训练扩散模型，并显著扩展时间训练范围，使模型能够捕捉长期依赖关系并保持持久记忆。第三，我们进行后训练蒸馏和记忆压缩，以提高推理效率，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性。实验表明，相较于先前的可控视频生成方法，Streaming-AAA在视觉保真度、帧率、延迟和长期稳定性方面均有显著提升，为交互式AAA游戏视频生成带来了明显更可玩的体验。

papers.title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
papers.translated_title: 修复孪生体，而非检测器：基于数字孪生数据的仿真到真实路侧激光雷达检测
papers.author: KuanLin Chen
papers.summary: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.
papers.translated_summary: 路边激光雷达检测器在真实标签上训练成本高昂，数字孪生有望替代这些标签，但在孪生上训练的检测器在真实场地会遇到不同的传感器、不同的物体和不同的标注惯例。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（IEEE BigData 2026 Cup）的LUMPI赛道中获得第一名（综合得分0.5541）、在其V2X-Real赛道中获得第五名（0.8102）的流程。每个检测器都是仅用合成数据训练的CenterPoint模型，在单块8 GB笔记本电脑GPU上训练。大部分增益来自校正孪生与真实场地之间的差异，而非来自检测器。我们将孪生的坐标、点密度和框惯例与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生缺失的行人和骑行者，以及作为未标注负样本的街道杂物，并按真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生物体。一种非学习的重采样方法将点密度调整至未标注真实帧的逐单元点密度，使LUMPI的真实感从0.589提升至0.947，而真实帧之间的对应值为0.949。随后，无标签后处理利用了固定路边传感器所保证的特性：静态结构在每一帧中反复出现，真实物体具有特征性的点统计。我们并排报告每个组件在验证集和测试集上的增益，发现对系统性仿真到现实差异的校正能够迁移到测试集，通常保留其验证增益的四分之一到四分之三，而拟合验证集少量物体的选择则不能迁移。

papers.title: SEOYUN: Refusal-Inducing Exam Documents for AI-Glasses Pipelines
papers.translated_title: SEOYUN：面向AI眼镜流水线的拒答诱导考试文档
papers.author: Dohyeon Kwon
papers.summary: Camera-equipped glasses can convert an examination page into a query to a vision-language model (VLM). Device detection addresses possession; a complementary question is whether an examination document can reduce the usefulness of an unauthorized capture. We present SEOYUN, an application-specific framework for refusal-inducing exam documents, with optical and encoder-level interventions as extensions. We use reverse jailbreaking to describe the direction of the objective: inducing abstention rather than bypassing refusal. Refusal induction and defensive visual prompt injection already have precedents; our contribution is a threat model, analytical limits, and an evaluation protocol for examination use. We distinguish refusal from correct-answer leakage, show why removing an added dummy option is not itself a reduction in the original answer space, and derive a sampling comparison under explicitly stated camera assumptions. The protocol separates digital, simulated, and physical inputs and requires held-out evaluation after subject-specific selection. A local CSAT candidate corpus and rendering harness have been prepared, but this version reports no model-performance measurements, physical validation, or human-subject results. Accordingly, SEOYUN is a research framework, not a validated defense or a basis for allegations against individuals.
papers.translated_summary: 配备摄像头的眼镜可将试卷页面转换为对视觉语言模型（VLM）的查询。设备检测解决的是持有问题；一个互补的问题是，试卷文档能否降低未经授权拍摄的有用性。我们提出SEOYUN，一个面向特定应用的拒答诱导试卷框架，并以光学层面和编码器层面的干预作为扩展。我们使用逆向越狱来描述目标方向：诱导弃答而非绕过拒答。拒答诱导与防御性视觉提示注入已有先例；我们的贡献在于面向考试用途的威胁模型、分析性界限和评估协议。我们区分拒答与正确答案泄露，说明为何移除添加的虚拟选项本身并不构成对原始答案空间的缩减，并在明确陈述的摄像头假设下推导出采样比较。该协议区分数字、模拟和物理输入，并要求在按科目特定选择后进行留出评估。已准备本地CSAT候选语料库和渲染工具链，但本版本不报告任何模型性能测量、物理验证或人类受试者结果。因此，SEOYUN是一个研究框架，而非经过验证的防御措施，也不能作为针对个人提出指控的依据。

papers.title: The Delayed Societal Cost of Unfairness
papers.translated_title: 不公平的延迟社会成本
papers.author: Giovani Valdrighi
papers.summary: Fair machine learning typically evaluates the societal costs of a decision policy -- the loss incurred by the decision-maker (DM) and the unfair distribution of costs among demographic groups of decision-subjects (DS) -- on static data, where reducing one often comes at the expense of the other. Yet decisions change the populations on which they act, and prior work has shown that fairness interventions designed on static data may fail to benefit, or even harm, the disadvantaged group over time. We investigate a complementary question: When can a policy that is Pareto-optimal on pre-deployment data be outperformed by a fairer policy once each is evaluated on the population it induces, reducing costs for one stakeholder without increasing them for the other? In a setting where qualification scores evolve in response to binary decisions and their outcomes, we show that under Rawlsian fairness, which never lowers any group's acceptance rate, placing sufficiently high weight on fairness reduces societal costs whenever accepting disadvantaged DS at the DM's break-even point leaves them in a state less costly to the DM than rejecting them. Under egalitarian fairness, which may lower the advantaged group's acceptance rate, this additionally requires the reduction in DM loss on the disadvantaged group to outweigh the increase on the advantaged group. Under both fairness notions, however, when DM loss is accuracy-based, improvements in the post-deployment population may arise from declining DS qualification, revealing that gains for the DM do not necessarily translate into better outcomes for DS. Our results show that policy-induced population dynamics can overturn apparent performance-fairness trade-offs, allowing fairer policies to reduce the delayed societal costs of decision-making.
papers.translated_summary: 公平机器学习通常基于静态数据评估决策政策的社会成本，即决策者（DM）所承受的损失以及成本在决策对象（DS）各人口群体之间分配的不公平性，而在静态数据上，降低其中一项往往以另一项为代价。然而，决策会改变其所作用的人群，已有研究表明，基于静态数据设计的公平性干预措施在随时间推移后可能无法惠及弱势群体，甚至对其造成伤害。我们研究一个互补性问题：在何种条件下，一个在部署前数据上具有帕累托最优性的政策，会在各自基于其所诱导的人群进行评估时，被一个更公平的政策所超越，从而在不增加某一利益相关方成本的情况下降低另一方的成本？在资格分数随二元决策及其结果而演化的设定中，我们证明：在罗尔斯公平性下（该公平性从不降低任何群体的接受率），只要在决策者的盈亏平衡点接受弱势DS使其处于对DM而言比拒绝他们成本更低的状态，赋予公平性足够高的权重就会降低社会成本。在平等主义公平性下（该公平性可能降低优势群体的接受率），这还额外要求弱势群体上DM损失的减少超过优势群体上DM损失的增加。然而，在两种公平性概念下，当DM损失基于准确性时，部署后人群的改善可能源于DS资格的下降，这揭示出DM的收益并不必然转化为DS更好的结果。我们的结果表明，政策诱导的人群动态可以扭转表面上的性能—公平性权衡，使更公平的政策能够降低决策的延迟社会成本。

papers.title: Serialization Tax in Shared-Latent Exchangeable Decisions
papers.translated_title: 共享潜在可交换决策中的序列化税
papers.author: Siming Zhang
papers.summary: Accurate item probabilities can produce inaccurate group-level decisions. A system may score each item separately, yet act on whether enough hidden items succeed: show a slate, defer a panel decision, or inspect a batch. When items share an uncertain latent state, independent marginalization preserves means but removes dependence from the aggregate posterior. We call this error the serialization tax. For binary items sharing one success rate, classical convex-order comparisons give a more dispersed exact count law than any independent completion with the same total mean. We quantify variance and total-variation gaps, derive threshold separation under margin conditions, and connect posterior approximation to decision regret. Separate results cover non-binary outcomes, heterogeneous items, and sufficient posterior resolution. TaxScore identifies large hidden blocks with unresolved uncertainty near a decision boundary for routing to richer posterior heads. On pre-specified, hidden-target-free MovieLens 1M/10M audits, existing shared-latent heads improve high-score negative log-likelihood (NLL)/utility from 0.673/0.696 to 0.629/0.723 and from 0.670/0.691 to 0.639/0.715. Routing gives 0.006--0.012 full-population utility gains, with matched controls identifying their sources. Our code is available at https://github.com/SiminChang/Serialization-Tax-in-Shared-Latent-Exchangeable-Decisions.
papers.translated_summary: 准确的条目概率可能产生不准确的群体层面决策。一个系统可以分别对每个条目评分，却依据足够多的隐藏条目是否成功来采取行动：展示一个列表、推迟一个小组决策，或检查一个批次。当条目共享一个不确定的潜在状态时，独立的边缘化保留了均值，却从聚合后验中移除了依赖性。我们将这一误差称为序列化税。对于共享同一成功率的二元条目，经典凸序比较给出的精确计数律比任何具有相同总均值的独立完成都更为分散。我们量化了方差与全变差差距，在边际条件下推导出阈值分离，并将后验近似与决策遗憾联系起来。单独的结果涵盖非二元结果、异质条目以及充分的后验分辨率。TaxScore识别出在决策边界附近具有未解决不确定性的大型隐藏块，以便路由到更丰富的后验头。在预先指定、无隐藏目标的MovieLens 1M/10M审计中，现有的共享潜在头将高分负对数似然（NLL）/效用从0.673/0.696改善到0.629/0.723，并从0.670/0.691改善到0.639/0.715。路由带来0.006--0.012的全群体效用增益，匹配的对照识别了其来源。我们的代码可在https://github.com/SiminChang/Serialization-Tax-in-Shared-Latent-Exchangeable-Decisions获取。

papers.title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.translated_title: ForeSeek：面向长视频理解的前瞻驱动推理
papers.author: Yuchen Sun
papers.summary: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek
papers.translated_summary: 长视频理解作为一项基础而关键的视觉任务，正被基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视频智能体所革新。然而，这类智能体固有的检索驱动特性造成了一个显著瓶颈，迫使它们基于局部显著性被动地获取片段，而缺乏全局的时间规划。为解决这一问题，我们提出 ForeSeek，一种前瞻驱动的视频智能体，将长视频推理从被动检索转变为预测性探索。ForeSeek 不再盲目地探测时间线，而是对未见的时间区域形成视觉接地的预期，通过有针对性的观察加以验证，并基于新出现的证据持续优化其搜索，其中失败的预期可作为有信息量的信号用于有原则的回溯。此外，我们开发了一个两阶段训练框架，使 MLLM 具备前瞻引导的推理与高效决策能力。在五个长视频基准上的大量实验表明，ForeSeek 持续改善了长视频推理的效率—精度权衡，在观察帧数比最强的基于搜索的智能体少 2.5–4.4 倍的情况下，实现了具有竞争力或更优的精度。代码可在 https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek 获取。

papers.title: An open-source semi-automated workflow for multi-omics sample extraction
papers.translated_title: 用于多组学样本提取的开源半自动化工作流程
papers.author: Hall, D. R.
papers.summary: Multiomics analysis relies on extracting metabolites lipids and proteins from a single sample A widely used method for this is Metabolomics Proteomics and Lipidomics Extraction MPLEx a triphasic chloroform methanol water extraction but it is manually intensive and depends on skilled operators working around a fragile protein layer Here we present OpenMPLEx a semi automated MPLEx workflow for low cost open source Opentrons liquid handlers A minor change in chemistry pellets the protein so that a robot can collect the aqueous and organic phases from above We compared the automated workflow with two manual MPLEx protocols by liquid chromatography mass spectrometry LC MS based proteomics lipidomics and metabolomics The methods were roughly equivalent and measured similar differences between growth media We then scaled the workflow to 96 well plates and tested it on an 80 sample Pseudomonas putida experiment One operator took all 80 samples from cell pellets to LC MS data in a working week with about 3 h of hands on time rather than days at the bench and quantified about 3 900 protein groups All scripts labware definitions and print files are open source so that other laboratories can adapt the workflow
papers.translated_summary: 多组学分析依赖于从单个样本中提取代谢物、脂质和蛋白质。一种广泛使用的方法是代谢组学、蛋白质组学和脂质组学提取（MPLEx），即三相手性氯仿-甲醇-水提取，但该方法人工操作强度大，且依赖熟练操作人员在脆弱的蛋白质层周围进行操作。在此，我们提出OpenMPLEx，一种面向低成本开源Opentrons液体处理器的半自动化MPLEx工作流程。化学条件的微小改变使蛋白质形成沉淀，从而使机器人能够从上方收集水相和有机相。我们通过液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）为基础的蛋白质组学、脂质组学和代谢组学，将自动化工作流程与两种手动MPLEx方案进行了比较。各方法大致等效，并测量到生长培养基之间的相似差异。随后我们将工作流程扩展至96孔板，并在一个包含80个样本的恶臭假单胞菌实验中进行测试。一名操作人员在一个工作周内完成了全部80个样本从细胞沉淀到LC-MS数据的处理，手动操作时间约3小时，而非在实验台上耗费数天，并定量了约3900个蛋白质组。所有脚本、实验室器皿定义和打印文件均为开源，以便其他实验室能够适配该工作流程。

papers.title: Considering African savanna elephant conservation as a nature-based climate solution
papers.translated_title: 将非洲稀树草原象保护视为一种基于自然的气候解决方案
papers.author: Schmitz, O.
papers.summary: The conservation of African savanna ecosystems is recognized as making important contributions toward capturing and storing atmospheric carbon in vegetation and in soils to help mitigate climate change. Also, savannas are important for elephant conservation, which is an increasing priority throughout Africa. However, there is concern that elephants can damage and transform vegetation thereby compromising savanna ecosystems capacities to capture and store carbon. Yet, elephants can have positive effects by releasing body wastes that contribute to nutrient cycling to enhance vegetation productivity (and hence carbon capture). The release of carbon in dung and trampling of soils can enhance long-term carbon storage in soils. Thus, an ecologically holistic assessment of net elephant effects on carbon capture and storage requires accounting for the negative and positive effects together. We report on a holistic assessment of elephant effects using a carbon cycle model that compares savanna ecosystem carbon capture and storage between scenarios with and without elephants. The modeling estimates that elephants at a density of approximately 0.5 individuals per square kilometer could increase average net ecosystem carbon capture by 1.4 times (range of uncertainty of 0.4 to 5.5 times). Elephants are estimated to increase average long-term aboveground carbon stocks by 6.5 times (uncertainty of 2 to 10 times). Average long-term soil carbon storage is estimated to increase by 1.7 times (uncertainty of 0.6 to 5.3 times). The estimated annual carbon capture is large enough to be considered a negative emission in national emissions accounting from land use change, suggesting that savanna elephant conservation should be considered as a nature-based climate solution.
papers.translated_summary: 非洲稀树草原生态系统的保护被认为对捕获和储存大气中的碳于植被和土壤中、帮助缓解气候变化具有重要贡献。此外，稀树草原对大象保护具有重要意义，而大象保护在整个非洲日益成为优先事项。然而，人们担心大象可能破坏和改变植被，从而损害稀树草原生态系统捕获和储存碳的能力。然而，大象也可以通过释放身体排泄物促进养分循环、提高植被生产力（进而增强碳捕获）而产生积极影响。粪便中碳的释放和土壤践踏可以增强土壤中的长期碳储存。因此，对大象碳捕获和储存净效应的生态整体评估需要将负面和正面效应一并考虑。我们报告了一项使用碳循环模型对大象效应的整体评估，该模型比较了有无大象情景下稀树草原生态系统的碳捕获和储存。模型估计，大象密度约为每平方千米0.5头时，可使平均净生态系统碳捕获增加1.4倍（不确定性范围为0.4至5.5倍）。据估计，大象可使平均长期地上碳储量增加6.5倍（不确定性为2至10倍）。平均长期土壤碳储存估计增加1.7倍（不确定性为0.6至5.3倍）。估计的年碳捕获量足够大，可在土地利用变化的国家排放核算中被视为负排放，这表明稀树草原大象保护应被视为一种基于自然的气候解决方案。

papers.title: Single-dose neonatal gene therapy preserves motor coordination and extends survival of Polg-deficient mice
papers.translated_title: 单剂量新生儿基因治疗可保持Polg缺陷小鼠的运动协调性并延长其生存期
papers.author: Zanin, S.
papers.summary: POLG mutations are the most common single nuclear gene cause of mitochondrial disease. POLG disease spans a spectrum of clinical presentations with variable age of onset and severity. Early-onset disease is often severe and fatal (e.g., Alpers syndrome, myocerebrohepatopathy), while late-onset disease can be relatively mild (e.g., progressive external ophthalmoplegia). POLG disease is incurable, with few symptomatic treatments available, none of which can prevent its progression. Gene replacement therapy has the potential to halt or prevent POLG disease, but its development has been hindered by the large size of the POLG cDNA and the scarcity of suitable mouse models. Here, we developed a bespoke Polg knockout (KO) mouse model by inactivating the Polg locus in parvalbumin-expressing neurons (e.g., Purkinje cells) and fast-twitch skeletal muscle fibers. KO mice developed progressive motor coordination deficits, respiratory chain deficiency in Purkinje cells and skeletal muscle, and died prematurely. We also developed nine AAV-based gene therapy vectors and confirmed their ability to deliver and express the human POL{gamma}A protein in different mouse tissues. A single high-dose administration of either of two lead candidates into Polg KO neonates preserved respiratory chain activity in Purkinje cells and skeletal muscle, delayed the onset of motor coordination deficits, and extended lifespan. Thus, our work provides preclinical proof of concept for gene replacement therapy for POLG disease, establishing the feasibility of this approach and laying the foundation for further development in the field.
papers.translated_summary: POLG突变是线粒体疾病最常见的单核基因病因。POLG疾病涵盖一系列临床表现，发病年龄和严重程度各异。早发型疾病通常严重且致命（如Alpers综合征、肌脑肝病），而晚发型疾病可能相对轻微（如进行性眼外肌麻痹）。POLG疾病无法治愈，可用的对症治疗极少，且均无法阻止其进展。基因替代疗法有潜力阻止或预防POLG疾病，但其开发受到POLG cDNA尺寸过大以及缺乏合适小鼠模型的阻碍。在此，我们通过在小清蛋白表达神经元（如浦肯野细胞）和快肌骨骼肌纤维中失活Polg基因座，开发了一种定制的Polg敲除（KO）小鼠模型。KO小鼠出现进行性运动协调障碍、浦肯野细胞和骨骼肌中的呼吸链缺陷，并过早死亡。我们还开发了九种基于AAV的基因治疗载体，并确认了它们在不同小鼠组织中递送和表达人POLγA蛋白的能力。将两种先导候选载体中的任一种以单次高剂量给予Polg KO新生小鼠，均能保持浦肯野细胞和骨骼肌中的呼吸链活性、延迟运动协调障碍的发生并延长寿命。因此，我们的工作为POLG疾病的基因替代疗法提供了临床前概念验证，确立了该方法的可行性，并为该领域的进一步开发奠定了基础。

papers.title: Convergent Genomic Signatures of Selection in Thar: Genetic trade-offs for desert survival
papers.translated_title: 沙漠羚羊中趋同的基因组选择特征：沙漠生存的遗传权衡
papers.author: Rathod, S. M.
papers.summary: Background: Desert environments provide a setting for natural biological experiments to cope up with simultaneous stressors of extreme temperatures, aridity, UV exposure, and limited food resources. Biological adaptations that support living in such an environment could become liabilities when the environment and lifestyle change due to gene-environment mismatch. We explored whether genetically and culturally diverse endogamous native populations of the Thar exhibit convergent signatures of selection to desert conditions and whether the selected loci have implications in traits and disease susceptibilities relevant to non-native transitions. Results: We report 348 high-confidence variants across 45 candidate genes from a study on 176 individuals from eight genetically distinct Thar populations. These genes identified from humans and other desert inhabitants display convergent evolution with multiple selection scans (PBSn1, Tajima`s D, iHS, and XPEHH) in diverse Thar populations. Prominent genes include ZNF385D, SGCZ, SARDH, SLC12A3, etc. Selected variants essential in the desert environment were associated with complex traits like lipid metabolism, hypertension, renal and cardiovascular diseases, and addiction in GWAS and PheWAS. Noteworthy, in a syntenic locus, eQTLs in SARDH, which modulates DBH implicated in addiction, suggest a potential link with survival advantage in an uncertain desert environment. Likewise, a selected variant (rs7204044) in SLC12A3, implicated in hypertension in non-desert populations, seems to be a key to water-salt homeostasis in desert natives. Conclusions: These findings suggest that variants linked to adaptive traits in desert conditions could be linked to maladaptation in an altered environment. This has potential health consequences in climatic and lifestyle transitions among native inhabitants.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：沙漠环境为自然生物学实验提供了场景，以应对极端温度、干旱、紫外线暴露和有限食物资源等同时存在的压力源。支持在这种环境中生存的生物学适应，当环境与生活方式因基因-环境失配而改变时，可能变为负担。我们探讨了塔尔地区遗传和文化上多样化的内婚制原住民群体是否表现出对沙漠条件的趋同选择信号，以及所选位点是否对与非原住民转变相关的性状和疾病易感性具有影响。结果：我们报告了来自8个遗传上不同的塔尔人群176个个体的研究中，45个候选基因中的348个高置信度变异。这些从人类和其他沙漠居民中鉴定出的基因，在多样化的塔尔人群中通过多次选择扫描（PBSn1、Tajima's D、iHS和XPEHH）显示出趋同进化。突出的基因包括ZNF385D、SGCZ、SARDH、SLC12A3等。在沙漠环境中至关重要的所选变异，在GWAS和PheAS中与脂质代谢、高血压、肾脏和心血管疾病以及成瘾等复杂性状相关。值得注意的是，在一个共线性位点中，SARDH的eQTLs（其调节与成瘾有关的DBH）暗示了与不确定沙漠环境中生存优势的潜在联系。同样，SLC12A3中的一个所选变异（rs7204044），在非沙漠人群中与高血压有关，似乎是沙漠原住民水盐稳态的关键。结论：这些发现表明，与沙漠条件下适应性性状相关的变异可能与改变环境中的适应不良有关。这对原住民在气候和生活方式转变中的健康具有潜在后果。

papers.title: SAM-Dependent Precursor Peptide Engagement by Darobactin Maturase DarE
papers.translated_title: Darobactin成熟酶DarE对SAM依赖的前体肽识别
papers.author: Zhu, W.
papers.summary: Radical S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) enzymes that synthesize structurally constrained ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) with therapeutic potential mostly do so by employing a dedicated RiPP recognition element (RRE). With the growing number of RRE-free maturases discovered, how these enzymes engage their substrates remains largely unexplored. In this work, we mapped substrate-enzyme interactions in DarE, an RRE-free radical SAM enzyme that installs the C-C and C-O-C crosslinks of the antibiotic darobactin during the first step of darobactin biosynthesis. Using anaerobic hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), we simultaneously resolved specific regions within the enzyme and its precursor peptide substrate, DarA, across five complex states. The N-terminal extension and part of the TIM-barrel domain of DarE, along with the leader region of DarA, become protected, revealing the peptide-engagement interface. Additional protection emerged only in the presence of SAM, identifying SAM as a key contributor to precursor-peptide engagement in an RRE-free RiPP maturase. Electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy further demonstrated precursor peptide-dependent perturbations of the chemical environment of the iron-sulfur clusters. These findings suggest that SAM-dependent peptide engagement, mediated in part by the N-terminal extension of the radical SAM enzyme, provides an alternative mechanism for precursor-peptide recognition in RRE-free RiPP maturases. Our work also demonstrates the utility of anaerobic HDX-MS for characterizing protein-peptide-small molecule interactions in oxygen-sensitive metalloenzymes.
papers.translated_summary: 合成结构受限、具有治疗潜力的核糖体合成及翻译后修饰肽（RiPPs）的自由基S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）酶，大多通过使用专用的RiPP识别元件（RRE）来实现这一过程。随着越来越多无RRE成熟酶的发现，这些酶如何与其底物结合在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们绘制了DarE中的底物-酶相互作用，DarE是一种无RRE的自由基SAM酶，在达罗巴汀生物合成的第一步中安装抗生素达罗巴汀的C-C和C-O-C交联。利用厌氧氢-氘交换质谱（HDX-MS），我们同时在五种复合物状态下解析了酶及其前体肽底物DarA内的特定区域。DarE的N端延伸和TIM桶结构域的一部分，以及DarA的前导区域，变得受到保护，揭示了肽结合界面。额外的保护仅在SAM存在时出现，表明SAM是无RRE RiPP成熟酶中前体肽结合的关键贡献者。电子顺磁共振波谱进一步证明了前体肽依赖性的铁硫簇化学环境扰动。这些发现表明，部分由自由基SAM酶的N端延伸介导的SAM依赖性肽结合，为无RRE RiPP成熟酶中的前体肽识别提供了一种替代机制。我们的工作还证明了厌氧HDX-MS在表征氧敏感金属酶中蛋白质-肽-小分子相互作用方面的实用性。

papers.title: Glycoform Distributions and Heparan Sulfate Binding of Intact SARS-CoV-2 Spike Variants by DIA-ECCR Native Mass Spectrometry
papers.translated_title: 完整SARS-CoV-2刺突变异体的糖型分布与硫酸乙酰肝素结合：DIA-ECCR天然质谱分析
papers.author: Xu, Z.
papers.summary: Glycosylation influences the structure, immunogenicity, and evolutionary selection of the SARS CoV 2 spike protein (S), but its extensive heterogeneity has hindered characterization of intact glycoform distributions. Here, we illustrate a data-independent analysis - electron capture charge reduction (DIA-ECCR) native mass spectrometry workflow for direct analysis of intact spike glycoforms across multiple variants. DIA-ECCR resolves variant-dependent differences in glycoform distributions and higher mass subpopulations. Monte Carlo simulations based on published site-specific bottom-up glycoproteomic data reproduce the central mass of the D614G experimental distribution and support a connection between intact and bottom-up measurements, while the broader experimental distributions and a second Gamma subpopulation indicate heterogeneity not captured by the simulations Mass photometry and charge detection mass spectrometry provide orthogonal measurements consistent with the DIA-ECCR results. DIA-ECCR also resolves mass shifts associated with binding of truncated heparan sulfate, demonstrating analysis of a heterogeneous protein:ligand complex. Together, these results outline a practical workflow that combines DIA-ECCR with native mass spectrometry (nMS) for characterizing intact glycoform distributions and ligand binding in highly heterogeneous glycoprotein assemblies, with potential applications in antigen characterization, vaccine design, and biopharmaceutical quality control.
papers.translated_summary: 糖基化影响SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白（S）的结构、免疫原性和进化选择，但其广泛的异质性阻碍了对完整糖型分布的表征。在此，我们展示了一种数据非依赖分析——电子捕获电荷减少（DIA-ECCR）天然质谱工作流程，用于直接分析多种变异株的完整刺突糖型。DIA-ECCR分辨出糖型分布和高质量亚群中变异株依赖的差异。基于已发表的位点特异性自下而上糖蛋白质组学数据的蒙特卡洛模拟再现了D614G实验分布的中心质量，并支持完整测量与自下而上测量之间的联系，而更宽泛的实验分布和第二个Gamma亚群则表明模拟未能捕获的异质性。质量光度法和电荷检测质谱法提供了与DIA-ECCR结果一致的 orthogonal 测量。DIA-ECCR还分辨出与截短硫酸乙酰肝素结合相关的质量偏移，展示了对异质性蛋白质:配体复合物的分析。总之，这些结果勾勒出一个将DIA-ECCR与天然质谱（nMS）相结合的实用工作流程，用于表征高度异质性糖蛋白组装体中的完整糖型分布和配体结合，在抗原表征、疫苗设计和生物制药质量控制中具有潜在应用。

papers.title: Crystal structure of the first de novo designed phosphotriesterase ZAPP-1
papers.translated_title: 首个从头设计的磷酸三酯酶ZAPP-1的晶体结构
papers.author: Woodbury, S. M.
papers.summary: Designing a de novo phosphotriesterase requires scaffolding a dinuclear metal center bound by six catalytic residues, including a post-translationally carbamylated lysine, in a pocket that must also bind a small, flexible organophosphate and orient it for hydrolysis. We recently met this challenge using RFdiffusion3 to design the first de novo phosphotriesterases, and biochemically characterized our first hit, ZAPP-1 [1]. Here we report two crystal structures of ZAPP-1 at 1.42 and 2.28 [A] resolution. The crystal structures are nearly identical to the design model scaffold (C RMSD = 0.69, 0.71, and 0.99 [A] for three copies across two independent crystals), and the higher-resolution crystal assembles the dinuclear Zn(II) site in the designed pocket with carbamylated K16. The catalytic residues are near the designed geometry but demonstrate flexibility across the structures, albeit mostly rotameric (C{beta} RMSD [≤] 0.8 [A] for both copies in form 1). AlphaFold3 predicts the designed catalytic conformation with substrate bound and the observed crystallographic deviations without it, suggesting an induced-fit mechanism upon substrate binding. Together with prior biochemical characterization, there is strong evidence that ZAPP-1 functions as designed, validating the high precision achievable with our RFdiffusion3 design pipeline, but the structures suggest that future design should better preorganize the active site. The ability to design experimentally accurate and increasingly sophisticated enzymes directly from the computer should enable a new future of programmable catalysis and chemistry.

papers.title: Multi-Layer Functional Metabolomics Reveals Chemical Interactions Between the Plant-Associated Bacterium Serratia marcescens and Phytophthora
papers.translated_title: 多层功能代谢组学揭示植物相关细菌粘质沙雷菌与疫霉之间的化学相互作用
papers.author: Herrera Rosero, D.
papers.summary: Oomycete pathogens of the genus Phytophthora cause devastating crop losses worldwide, highlighting the need for novel biocontrol agents. Here, we developed a multi-layer functional metabolomics workflow that incorporates an LC-MS/MS-based metal infusion assay in combination with microfractionation-based bioassays against Phytophthora infestans and metal-binding assays to map bioactivity from Serratia marcescens extracts. MS/MS analysis and feature-based molecular networking supported the annotation of activity-associated metabolites, including prodigiosin, serratiochelins, and an uncharacterized putative serratiochelin analog designated serratiochelin G. Complementary chrome azurol S assays and post-column iron infusion provided evidence of iron-binding properties. Comparative genomic analysis and L-lysine supplementation supported a proposed biosynthetic origin of serratiochelin G involving cadaverine incorporation. This workflow enables metabolite prioritization by integrating non-targeted LC-MS/MS with chromatographically resolved bioactivity and complementary functional assays.
papers.translated_summary: 疫霉属卵菌病原体在全球范围内造成毁灭性作物损失，凸显了对新型生物防治剂的需求。在此，我们开发了一种多层功能代谢组学工作流程，该流程将基于LC-MS/MS的金属灌注测定与基于微分离的生物测定相结合，针对致病疫霉进行活性检测，并通过金属结合测定来定位粘质沙雷氏菌提取物中的生物活性。MS/MS分析和基于特征分子的网络分析支持了对活性相关代谢物的注释，包括灵菌红素、serratiochelins以及一种未表征的推定serratiochelin类似物，命名为serratiochelin G。互补的铬天青S测定和柱后铁灌注提供了铁结合特性的证据。比较基因组分析和L-赖氨酸补充支持了涉及尸胺掺入的serratiochelin G生物合成起源的推测。该工作流程通过整合非靶向LC-MS/MS与色谱分离的生物活性和互补功能测定，实现了代谢物的优先级排序。

papers.title: Mechanistic Insights into ADAR1-p110 Nuclear Import: A Dual-Interface Interaction with Transportin-1
papers.translated_title: ADAR1-p110核输入的机制洞察：与Transportin-1的双界面相互作用
papers.author: Chin, D. H. R.
papers.summary: The human ADAR1 exists as two isoforms: the predominantly cytoplasmic-localized p150, recognized for its role in suppression of aberrant immune activation, and the predominantly nuclear-localized p110 (missing the N terminal Z domain), whose biological functions remain less understood but are thought to rely heavily on its subcellular localization. Despite its structural similarity to the Z domain unique to ADAR1-p150, the functional significance of the Z{beta} domain shared by both isoforms remains unclear. Here, we identify an additional mechanism contributing to the nuclear import of ADAR1-p110 through a dual-interface interaction with transportin-1 (TNPO1), involving both the Z{beta} and dsRBD3 domains of ADAR1. Using cryo-electron microscopy, we show that Z{beta} engages TNPO1 at its canonical cargo-binding groove, while dsRBD3 binds at a peripheral site overlapping the RanGTP binding interface. Structure-guided mutagenesis and biochemical analyses support the contribution of Z{beta} to TNPO1 recognition. Disruption of the interaction between ADAR1 Z{beta} domain and TNPO1 alters the nucleocytoplasmic distribution of ADAR1-p110, resulting in increased cytoplasmic accumulation despite the retention of the previously characterized dsRBD3-associated nuclear localization signal. Furthermore, cytoplasmic redistribution of ADAR1-p110 mutants is accompanied by global suppression of cytosolic innate immune signaling pathways and reduced expression of interferon-stimulated genes. Together, these findings identify ADAR1 Z{beta} as an additional TNPO1-recognition element synergizing with dsRBD3 that contributes to ADAR1-p110 nuclear localization and highlight the relationship between its subcellular distribution and immune regulatory activity.
papers.translated_summary: 人类ADAR1存在两种异构体：主要定位于细胞质的p150，因其抑制异常免疫激活的作用而被认识；以及主要定位于细胞核的p110（缺失N端Z结构域），其生物学功能尚不清楚，但被认为高度依赖其亚细胞定位。尽管p110与ADAR1-p150特有的Z结构域在结构上相似，但两种异构体共有的Zβ结构域的功能意义仍不明确。在此，我们鉴定了一种额外机制，该机制通过ADAR1与transportin-1（TNPO1）的双界面相互作用促进ADAR1-p110的核输入，该相互作用涉及ADAR1的Zβ和dsRBD3结构域。利用冷冻电镜，我们显示Zβ以TNPO1的经典货物结合槽与其结合，而dsRBD3则结合于与RanGTP结合界面重叠的外周位点。结构指导的突变分析和生化分析支持Zβ对TNPO1识别的贡献。破坏ADAR1 Zβ结构域与TNPO1之间的相互作用会改变ADAR1-p110的核质分布，导致尽管保留了先前表征的dsRBD3相关核定位信号，细胞质积累仍增加。此外，ADAR1-p110突变体的细胞质再分布伴随着胞质先天免疫信号通路的整体抑制以及干扰素刺激基因表达的降低。总之，这些发现将ADAR1 Zβ鉴定为一种额外的TNPO1识别元件，其与dsRBD3协同作用，促进ADAR1-p110的核定位，并强调了其亚细胞分布与免疫调节活性之间的关系。

papers.title: ProlateNet: Sampling-rate transfer of convolutional networks with a weights-only certificate for physiological signals
papers.translated_title: ProlateNet：具有仅权重证书的卷积网络采样率迁移用于生理信号
papers.author: Cui, H.
papers.summary: A central goal of physiological signal analysis is to train a model once and deploy it across recording systems. However, these systems sample EEG and ECG at different rates, and a network trained at one rate loses accuracy at the others. Continuous-kernel networks were built to solve this problem, but published ones still fail at unseen rates, and no existing method can certify a trained model before deployment. In this study, we propose ProlateNet, which builds kernels from prolate spheroidal wave functions to suppress aliasing across sampling rates and certifies a trained model from its weights alone. Across fourteen first-layer designs trained at one rate on three public EEG and ECG datasets, the published continuous-kernel layers FlexConv and sampling-frequency-independent (SFI) convolution show mean worst drops of 0.18 and 0.35 macro-F1 on SEED. ProlateNet is the only design that is stable and accurate on all three datasets with an error bound fixed before training, and its mean worst drop is at most 0.003. Without target-rate recordings, its certificate ranks the continuous-kernel designs on SEED by measured transfer with Spearman {rho} = 0.92, against 0.68 for energy above the training Nyquist frequency. Overall, ProlateNet shows that controlling aliasing enables convolutional networks to transfer across sampling rates and provides principled guidance for building physiological signal models that are trained once and deployed across recording systems.

papers.title: Antibiotic prescribing and resistance beyond hospital surveillance networks in India
papers.translated_title: 印度医院监测网络之外的抗生素处方与耐药性
papers.author: Kaur, J.
papers.summary: Hospital-based networks provide much of the antimicrobial resistance surveillance evidence in India, but community-facing data on both prescribing and resistance remain limited. We analysed 2.78 million prescription-validated antibiotic records and 155,764 microbiology samples from Tata 1mg, a digital healthcare platform, during 2023-2025. We assessed prescribing composition and resistance trends, and explored ecological prescribing-resistance associations using merged monthly series. Access antibiotics accounted for 28.7% of records, compared with 47.0% for Watch and 11.9% for Not Recommended antibiotics. Across 25 eligible states and union territories, Access shares ranged from 16.1% to 38.0%. Urine comprised 93.9% of samples. Among urinary Escherichia coli isolates, resistance was 4.9% to nitrofurantoin and amikacin, compared with 53.6% to ceftriaxone and 57.0% to ciprofloxacin. Exploratory prescribing-resistance associations varied by organism and antibiotic. These findings identify stewardship priorities within a digitally mediated care pathway and illustrate the complementary value of routinely collected pharmacy and laboratory data for surveillance beyond hospital-centred networks. but community-facing data on both prescribing and resistance remain limited. papers.translated_summary: 基于医院的网络提供了印度抗菌药物耐药性监测的大部分证据，但面向社区的处方和耐药性数据仍然有限。我们分析了2023至2025年间来自数字医疗平台Tata 1mg的278万条经处方验证的抗生素记录和155764份微生物学样本。我们评估了处方构成和耐药性趋势，并使用合并的月度序列探索了生态学层面的处方-耐药性关联。可及类抗生素占记录的28.7%，而观察类占47.0%，不推荐类占11.9%。在25个符合条件的邦和联邦属地中，可及类占比范围为16.1%至38.0%。尿液占样本的93.9%。在尿液来源的大肠埃希菌分离株中，对呋喃妥因和阿米卡星的耐药率为4.9%，而对头孢曲松的耐药率为53.6%，对环丙沙星的耐药率为57.0%。探索性处方-耐药性关联因病原体和抗生素而异。这些发现确定了数字化介导的诊疗路径中的管理优先事项，并说明了常规收集的药房和实验室数据对于超越以医院为中心网络的监测的补充价值。

papers.title: Methylphenidate-induced changes in target-enriched functional connectivity in ADHD
papers.translated_title: 注意缺陷多动障碍中哌甲酯诱导的目标富集功能连接变化
papers.author: van der Pal, Z.
papers.summary: Methylphenidate is the most widely used pharmacological treatment for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and acts primarily by blocking dopamine and noradrenaline transporters, increasing catecholamine availability. However, how these molecular actions translate into large-scale functional brain network changes, and how such changes relate to cognition, remains unclear. Moreover, methylphenidate effects have been shown to depend on age, yet whether this extends to molecularly informed brain networks is unknown. In a pre-post challenge design, 83 stimulant treatment-na&iumlve children and adults with ADHD underwent resting-state fMRI before and after a single methylphenidate dose (0.5 mg/kg). We applied Receptor-Enriched Analysis of functional Connectivity by Targets (REACT), which uses positron emission tomography (PET) maps of molecular target density to estimate, for each target, whole-brain functional connectivity (FC) with the regions where that target is most abundant. PET maps of the dopamine transporter (DAT), noradrenaline transporter (NAT), and dopamine D1 and D2/3 receptors were modelled jointly, so that each target-enriched FC map reflects that target's unique contribution. We further compared children and adults, and explored associations with response inhibition. Methylphenidate shifted DAT- and D2/3-enriched FC towards less negative values and NAT-enriched FC towards less positive values, whereas D1-enriched FC did not change significantly. Target-enriched FC responses were broadly comparable across children and adults, and associations with response inhibition were not robust to controlling for head motion. These findings show that methylphenidate alters FC patterns linked to distinct catecholaminergic systems, supporting molecularly informed connectivity as a framework for studying the neural effects of pharmacological treatment in ADHD.
papers.translated_summary: 哌甲酯是注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）最广泛使用的药物治疗，主要通过阻断多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素转运体，增加儿茶酚胺的可用性。然而，这些分子作用如何转化为大规模功能性脑网络变化，以及这些变化如何与认知相关，仍不清楚。此外，哌甲酯的效应已被证明依赖于年龄，但这是否延伸至分子信息指导的脑网络尚不清楚。在一项前后挑战设计中，83名未接受过兴奋剂治疗的ADHD儿童和成人分别在单次哌甲酯剂量（0.5 mg/kg）前后接受了静息态fMRI。我们应用了基于靶点的受体富集功能连接分析（REACT），该方法利用分子靶点密度的正电子发射断层扫描（PET）图，针对每个靶点估计全脑功能连接（FC）与该靶点最丰富区域之间的关系。多巴胺转运体（DAT）、去甲肾上腺素转运体（NAT）以及多巴胺D1和D2/3受体的PET图被联合建模，使每个靶点富集的FC图反映该靶点的独特贡献。我们进一步比较了儿童和成人，并探讨了与反应抑制的关联。哌甲酯使DAT和D2/3富集的FC向较少负值方向移动，使NAT富集的FC向较少正值方向移动，而D1富集的FC未显著变化。靶点富集的FC反应在儿童和成人之间大致相当，与反应抑制的关联在控制头动后不稳健。这些发现表明，哌甲酯改变了与不同儿茶酚胺能系统相关的FC模式，支持分子信息指导的连接性作为研究ADHD药物治疗神经效应的框架。

papers.title: Bivariate Multiscale Sample Entropy of Frontoparietal-Subgenual ACC Dynamics in Depression During Accelerated TMS at 7 T
papers.translated_title: 抑郁症加速经颅磁刺激7T下额顶-膝下前扣带回动力学的双变量多尺度样本熵
papers.author: Denier, N.
papers.summary: ObjectiveTo examine whether longitudinal changes in frontoparietal (FP)-subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC) joint temporal complexity differ between sgACC hemispheres in patients undergoing accelerated TMS (aTMS) and untreated healthy controls. MethodsTwenty-four patients with current depressive episodes and fifteen healthy controls underwent 7T resting-state fMRI at baseline and follow-up. Patients received aTMS localized to the left DLPFC using Beam-F3. The same bilateral FP time series was paired separately with left and right sgACC time series. Bivariate multiscale sample entropy (bMSE) across scale factors a1-a10 was summarized by trapezoidal integration as a complexity index (bMSE-CI). The primary test was the Group x Time x sgACC Hemisphere interaction in a mixed repeated- measures ANOVA. Scale-specific interactions and clinical Spearman correlations were evaluated with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Change scores were follow-up minus baseline. ResultsThe bMSE-CI Group x Time x Hemisphere interaction was significant (F(1,37) = 6.043, p = 0.0188, partial {superscript 2} = 0.140). Mean left/right bMSE-CI changes were -0.286/+0.124 in patients and +0.323/+0.112 in controls. Of ten scale-specific three-way interactions, only a2 survived FDR correction (q = 0.0435). No baseline or change-score bMSE-MADRS association survived the specified FDR corrections. A random-intercept-only mixed-model sensitivity analysis did not reach statistical significance for the three-way interaction (p = 0.0718). ConclusionFP-sgACC joint temporal complexity showed hemisphere-dependent longitudinal differences between patients undergoing aTMS and healthy controls. These exploratory findings motivate further evaluation of bMSE as a candidate measure of longitudinal neural change in depression. Independent replication, more precise reliability estimates, and prospective validation of clinical relevance are needed.

papers.title: An fMRI Phenotype of Reward in Effort Expenditure in the VTA and Dorsal Raphe: A Longitudinal Study of Depression under Escitalopram Treatment
papers.translated_title: VTA与背侧中缝中努力付出奖励的fMRI表型：艾司西酞普兰治疗下抑郁症的纵向研究
papers.author: Hajric, M.
papers.summary: Anhedonia and motivational impairment are central features of major depressive disorder, yet the neural processes linking reward information processing to sustained goal-directed behaviour remain insufficiently understood. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging, we examined representations of reward levels during sustained effort expenditure (a construct in the RDoC framework) as a distinct component of reward processing in depressive patients under escitalopram treatment. Twenty-eight unmedicated patients with a current depressive episode and forty-three healthy control participants underwent fMRI scanning at two time points three weeks apart; patients started escitalopram immediately after the first measurement. Across participants, sustained effort expenditure engaged midbrain reward circuitry (ventral tegmental area, VTA), even in the absence of immediate reinforcement. Here, we observed a reward level x session x patient group interaction, driven by larger activity in patients after treatment. A targeted analysis also revealed changes in activity of the dorsal raphe nucleus (DRN) in patients. By isolating neural mechanisms supporting sustained goal-directed behaviour, the study identifies novel and clinically relevant imaging phenotypes of reward processing and their change after three weeks of treatment, representing a potential pathway of escitalopram treatment in depression.
papers.translated_summary: 快感缺失和动机损害是重性抑郁障碍的核心特征，然而将奖赏信息处理与持续的目标导向行为联系起来的神经过程仍未被充分理解。我们使用功能磁共振成像，考察了在持续努力付出（RDoC框架中的一个构念）期间奖赏水平的表征，将其作为接受艾司西酞普兰治疗的抑郁患者奖赏处理的一个独立成分。二十八名当前处于抑郁发作期且未服药的 patient 和四十三名健康对照参与者相隔三周在两个时间点接受了fMRI扫描；患者在第一次测量后立即开始服用艾司西酞普兰。在所有参与者中，持续努力付出激活了中脑奖赏环路（腹侧被盖区，VTA），即使在缺乏即时强化的情况下也是如此。在此，我们观察到奖赏水平× session ×患者组的交互作用，其驱动因素是患者治疗后活动增强。一项针对性分析还揭示了患者中背侧中缝核（DRN）活动的变化。通过分离支持持续目标导向行为的神经机制，该研究识别出奖赏处理的新颖且具有临床相关性的影像学表型及其在三周治疗后的变化，代表了艾司西酞普兰治疗抑郁的一种潜在通路。

papers.title: Association of mRNA COVID-19 vaccination with overall survival in patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors: a retrospective cohort analysis.
papers.translated_title: mRNA COVID-19疫苗接种与接受免疫检查点抑制剂患者总生存期的关联：一项回顾性队列分析。
papers.author: Cheng, M. T.
papers.summary: Background: A retrospective study in Nature recently reported improved overall survival (OS) when COVID-19 mRNA vaccination was administered around initiation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy. Whether this association depends on vaccination timing relative to ICI treatment remains unclear. Methods: We conducted a single-centre retrospective cohort study of patients receiving palliative-intent ICI therapy at a UK tertiary cancer centre between October 2014 and December 2025. Two vaccination exposure definitions were evaluated: (1) vaccination from 100 days before to 100 days after the first ICI cycle (initial window); and (2) vaccination from 100 days before the first ICI cycle to 100 days after the final ICI cycle (extended window). Multivariable Cox models adjusted for age, sex, treatment line and year of ICI initiation, with the baseline hazard stratified by tumour group. Landmark, time-varying, pre-ICI, active vaccinated comparator and calendar-restricted analyses were performed. Results: Among 2,054 patients, 493 (24.0%) received [≥]1 COVID-19 vaccination. In the initial fixed-window analysis, mRNA vaccination was not significantly associated with OS (HR 0.80; 95% CI 0.60-1.06; p=0.123). No significant association was observed in day-100 landmark, initial time-varying or pre-ICI analyses. The active vaccinated comparator analysis was also non-significant. In the extended fixed-window analysis, longer OS was associated with mRNA (HR 0.59; 95% CI 0.46-0.76; p<0.001) and adenoviral-vector vaccination (HR 0.65; 95% CI 0.51-0.83; p<0.001). The mRNA association was attenuated in calendar-restricted analyses and was non-significant in the supportive time-varying analysis (HR 0.82; 95% CI 0.66-1.04; p=0.099). Conclusions: Survival associations with COVID-19 mRNA vaccination varied according to exposure definition and analytic handling of vaccination timing. The strong association observed in the extended fixed-window analysis was attenuated in calendar-restricted and supportive time-varying analyses. Prospective studies are required to determine whether COVID-19 mRNA vaccination at specific time points during ICI therapy influences clinical outcomes.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：近期《自然》杂志的一项回顾性研究报道，在免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗启动前后接种COVID-19 mRNA疫苗可改善总生存期（OS）。该关联是否取决于疫苗接种相对于ICI治疗的时间尚不清楚。方法：我们在英国一家三级癌症中心开展了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2014年10月至2025年12月期间接受姑息性ICI治疗的患者。评估了两种疫苗接种暴露定义：（1）从首次ICI周期前100天至后100天接种疫苗（初始窗口）；（2）从首次ICI周期前100天至末次ICI周期后100天接种疫苗（扩展窗口）。多变量Cox模型校正年龄、性别、治疗线数及ICI启动年份，基线风险按肿瘤组分层。进行了地标分析、时变分析、ICI前分析、活性疫苗接种对照分析及日历限制分析。结果：在2,054例患者中，493例（24.0%）接受了至少1剂COVID-19疫苗接种。在初始固定窗口分析中，mRNA疫苗接种与OS无显著关联（HR 0.80；95% CI 0.60-1.06；p=0.123）。在第100天地标分析、初始时变分析或ICI前分析中均未观察到显著关联。活性疫苗接种对照分析亦无显著性。在扩展固定窗口分析中，较长OS与mRNA疫苗接种相关（HR 0.59；95% CI 0.46-0.76；p<0.001）及腺病毒载体疫苗接种相关（HR 0.65；95% CI 0.51-0.83；p<0.001）。mRNA关联在日历限制分析中减弱，在支持性时变分析中无显著性（HR 0.82；95% CI 0.66-1.04；p=0.099）。结论：COVID-19 mRNA疫苗接种与生存的关联因暴露定义及对疫苗接种时间的分析处理方式而异。在扩展固定窗口分析中观察到的强关联在日历限制分析和支持性时变分析中减弱。需要前瞻性研究以确定在ICI治疗期间特定时间点接种COVID-19 mRNA疫苗是否影响临床结局。

papers.title: Impact of wildfire-related fine particulate matter on tuberculosis notifications in Brazil: a nationwide panel study, 2003-2023
papers.translated_title: 野火相关细颗粒物对巴西结核病报告的影响：2003-2023年全国面板研究
papers.author: Pham, T. M.
papers.summary: Wildfire activity is intensifying with climate and land-use change, but its consequences for chronic infectious diseases remain poorly understood. We linked monthly tuberculosis notifications to wildfire-related fine particulate matter (PM2.5) across 5,544 Brazilian municipalities (notifications 2005-2023; exposure 2003-2023), using a fixed-effects distributed-lag panel design that accounts for meteorology, diagnostic coverage, seasonality, and state-level trends. Fourteen additional high-exposure days (PM2.5 >25 {micro}g/m3) in a month were associated with an average increase of 2.7% [95% CI: 0.9-4.5%] in tuberculosis notifications in each of the following 24 months, peaking 11 months (IQR: 11-12) after exposure. Wildfire-related PM2.5 exposure accounted for 2.0% [0.7-3.2%] of notifications in exposed municipality-months, with the largest attributable fractions in Pantanal (12.3%, 95% CI: 8.7-15.7%) and Amazonia (6.4%, 95% CI: 5.2-7.7%). These results suggest that wildfire-related PM2.5 has a delayed effect on tuberculosis, extending health consequences of wildfire smoke beyond acute respiratory and cardiovascular outcomes and identifying a potential window for exposure-informed surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 野火活动正随着气候和土地利用变化而加剧，但其对慢性传染病的影响仍知之甚少。我们将月度结核病通报数据与野火相关的细颗粒物（PM2.5）进行关联，覆盖巴西5，544个市镇（通报数据2005—2023年；暴露数据2003—2023年），采用固定效应分布滞后面板设计，并控制气象因素、诊断覆盖率、季节性和州级趋势。一个月内额外出现14个高暴露日（PM2.5 >25 μg/m3）与随后24个月中每个月的结核病通报平均增加2.7%[95% CI：0.9—4.5%]相关，在暴露后第11个月达到峰值（IQR：11—12）。在暴露的市镇—月份中，野火相关PM2.5暴露占通报病例的2.0%[0.7—3.2%]，归因分数最高的是潘塔纳尔（12.3%，95% CI：8.7—15.7%）和亚马逊地区（6.4%，95% CI：5.2—7.7%）。这些结果表明，野火相关PM2.5对结核病具有滞后效应，将野火烟雾的健康后果扩展至急性呼吸和心血管结局之外，并识别出一个可用于暴露知情监测的潜在窗口期。

papers.title: Time of Day Dependent Effectiveness of Anti-IgE Therapy in Asthma: Clinical and Experimental Evidence
papers.translated_title: 抗IgE治疗哮喘的疗效随一天中的时间变化：临床与实验证据
papers.author: Akenroye, A.
papers.summary: BackgroundAsthma is a time-sensitive inflammatory disease whose activity exhibits daily (circadian) rhythms. An outstanding question is whether such temporal variations extend to advanced asthma treatments like biologics that are used for moderate-to-severe disease. ObjectiveTo examine how time-of-administration relates to the effectiveness of the anti-IgE biologic, omalizumab. MethodsWe performed a retrospective cohort study of omalizumab effectiveness in 153 patients with asthma with timestamped administration records. Time of day was modeled as a continuous variable and dichotomized into morning (8:00-11:59, n=74) versus afternoon (12:00-17:00, n=79) administration. Multivariable logistic regression and Cox time-to-event analyses were used to adjust for key covariates. For biological validation, we treated ovalbumin (OVA)-sensitized mice with anti-IgE antibody at various times of day and measured its impact on inflammatory lung pathology. ResultsReceiving the initial dose of omalizumab in the afternoon was associated with better response, defined as a 50% or more reduction in asthma exacerbations in the year after initiation (Odds ratio, OR: 5.20; 95% CI, 1.94-13.96). For each hour later in the day the initial dose of omalizumab was given, the odds of a response increased by 34% (adjusted OR, 1.34; 1.02-1.77). In OVA-sensitized mice, anti-IgE treatment attenuated inflammatory lung pathology, including OVA-induced airway hyperresponsiveness and type-2 inflammation-related gene expression, in a time-of-day-sensitive manner, with maximum effectiveness when dosed in the latter part of the dark phase, functionally analogous to the afternoon in humans. ConclusionThe timing of anti-IgE treatment for asthma may influence therapeutic success. These findings have implications for optimizing the effectiveness of respiratory biologics. Take-home messagesO_LIIgE-targeted therapy in patients with asthma and in murine experimental asthma varied in effectiveness based on administration time. C_LIO_LIIn patients, receiving the first omalizumab dose in the PM (vs. AM) was associated with better treatment response. C_LI
papers.translated_summary: 背景：哮喘是一种时间敏感性的炎症性疾病，其活动呈现每日（昼夜）节律。一个突出的问题是，这种时间变化是否延伸至用于中重度疾病的先进哮喘治疗手段，如生物制剂。目的：探讨给药时间与抗IgE生物制剂奥马珠单抗有效性之间的关系。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性队列研究，评估奥马珠单抗在153例具有时间戳给药记录的哮喘患者中的有效性。将一天中的时间建模为连续变量，并二分为上午（8：00-11：59，n=74）与下午（12：00-17：00，n=79）给药。采用多变量logistic回归和Cox时间-事件分析对关键协变量进行调整。为进行生物学验证，我们在一天中的不同时间用抗IgE抗体治疗卵清蛋白（OVA）致敏小鼠，并测量其对炎症性肺病理的影响。结果：下午接受奥马珠单抗初始剂量与更好的应答相关，应答定义为开始治疗后一年内哮喘急性发作减少50%或以上（比值比，OR：5.20；95%CI，1.94-13.96）。奥马珠单抗初始剂量给药时间每延后一小时，应答的比值增加34%（校正OR，1.34；1.02-1.77）。在OVA致敏小鼠中，抗IgE治疗以对一天中时间敏感的方式减轻炎症性肺病理，包括OVA诱导的气道高反应性和2型炎症相关基因表达，在暗期后半段给药时有效性最大，在功能上类似于人类的下午。结论：哮喘抗IgE治疗的时机可能影响治疗成功。这些发现对优化呼吸系统生物制剂的有效性具有重要意义。要点：O_LI在哮喘患者和小鼠实验性哮喘中，靶向IgE的治疗的有效性因给药时间而异。C_LIO_LI在患者中，下午（而非上午）接受首剂奥马珠单抗与更好的治疗应答相关。C_LI

papers.title: Evaluating symptoms and sensors for menstrual phase estimation beyond bleeding and cycle position
papers.translated_title: 评估月经期估计的症状和传感器：超越出血和周期位置
papers.author: Specht, B.
papers.summary: Whether symptoms and sensor measurements improve menstrual phase estimation beyond bleeding and cycle position remains unclear. We compared input combinations for four-phase estimation in 42 mcPHASES participants using nested feature selection and leave-one-participant-out evaluation against reference phases derived from hormones and menstrual flow. Across two tree-based classifiers, additional symptoms and sensors produced little consistent improvement over bleeding and bleeding-derived cycle position. With a gradient-boosted tree classifier, adding sensors to bleeding, position and symptoms changed macro F1 by +0.17 percentage points (95% confidence interval [-0.61, +1.04]). With sensors alone, features representing recent changes, trends and deviations from participants' prior averages increased macro F1 from 30.08% to 43.55%. The sensor-only estimates used temporal filtering to incorporate expected phase order and duration using only current and past observations. Fertility had the lowest phase-specific F1, limiting interpretation for fertility-related decisions. Sensor measurements thus provided information about menstrual phase but offered little consistent additional benefit when bleeding and cycle position were already known. Studies evaluating additional symptoms or sensor measurements should include bleeding and bleeding-derived cycle position as baselines to establish their incremental predictive value.
papers.translated_summary: 症状和传感器测量是否能在出血和周期位置之外改善月经期估计仍不清楚。我们使用嵌套特征选择和留一参与者评估，在42名mcPHASES参与者中比较了四阶段估计的输入组合，并以源自激素和月经流量的参考阶段作为对照。在两种基于树的分类器中，额外的症状和传感器相较于出血和出血衍生的周期位置仅产生很小的一致性改善。使用梯度提升树分类器时，将传感器加入出血、位置和症状使宏观F1变化+0.17个百分点（95%置信区间[-0.61，+1.04]）。仅使用传感器时，代表近期变化、趋势和偏离参与者先前平均值的特征将宏观F1从30.08%提高到43.55%。仅传感器的估计使用时间滤波，仅利用当前和过去观察来纳入预期阶段顺序和持续时间。生育力的阶段特异性F1最低，限制了对生育相关决策的解释。因此，传感器测量提供了关于月经期的信息，但当出血和周期位置已知时，几乎没有提供一致性的额外益处。评估额外症状或传感器测量的研究应将出血和出血衍生的周期位置作为基线，以确立其增量预测价值。

papers.title: Privacy Preserving Federated Gradient Boosting for Single Record Patient Devices
papers.translated_title: 面向单记录患者设备的隐私保护联邦梯度提升
papers.author: Specht, B.
papers.summary: Learning from data on personal devices requires methods that accommodate limited local records, intermittent availability and privacy constraints. Here we present PrivateBoost, a federated gradient boosting framework that allows clients to contribute individual records without fitting local models or coordinating with other clients. Each device distributes cryptographic shares of its contribution to a fixed set of shareholders, and an aggregator reconstructs their sums for training. Simulations on four medical datasets containing up to 70,692 records show predictive performance comparable to matched centralised training and resilience to simulated client dropout. Per-client communication ranges from approximately 0.6 to 4.2 megabytes in loopback measurements for models with 15 trees of maximum depth three. In a physical deployment, four consumer smartphones and tablets, each holding a batch of records, complete three training sessions unattended during operating-system-managed background execution. Median share-generation times range from 0.3 to 1.0 milliseconds per round. These results demonstrate single-record learning in simulation and show that mobile participation can fit within brief background execution windows, without requiring users to keep an application open.
papers.translated_summary: 从个人设备上的数据中学习，需要能够适应有限本地记录、间歇性可用性和隐私约束的方法。在此我们提出 PrivateBoost，一种联邦梯度提升框架，允许客户端贡献单条记录，而无需拟合本地模型或与其他客户端协调。每台设备将其贡献的密码学份额分发给一组固定的份额持有者，聚合器重构其总和以用于训练。在包含多达 70,692 条记录的四组医学数据集上的模拟显示，其预测性能与匹配的集中式训练相当，并且对模拟的客户端掉线具有韧性。在最大深度为三的 15 棵树模型的回环测量中，每客户端通信量约为 0.6 至 4.2 兆字节。在实际部署中，四部消费级智能手机和平板电脑各自持有一批记录，在操作系统管理的后台执行期间无人值守地完成了三次训练会话。每轮份额生成时间的中位数为 0.3 至 1.0 毫秒。这些结果展示了模拟中的单记录学习，并表明移动端参与可以适应短暂的后台执行窗口，而无需用户保持应用程序打开。

papers.title: HIV incidence declines and changing age patterns of new infections in sub-Saharan Africa: evidence from empirical studies and insights from mathematical models
papers.translated_title: 撒哈拉以南非洲HIV发病率下降及新感染年龄模式变化：来自实证研究的证据与数学模型的启示
papers.author: Stevens, O.
papers.summary: Background: HIV incidence in sub-Saharan Africa is estimated to have declined substantially since 2000. We assessed whether estimated incidence levels, trends, and patterns were consistent with empirical observations. Methods: We updated a systematic review of adult HIV incidence data from sub-Saharan Africa with data published 2019-2024. We matched empirical incidence measurements 1990-2023 to UNAIDS modelled HIV incidence estimates by study area, sex, age group, and year. We used Bayesian mixed-effects Poisson regression to estimate adjusted incidence rate ratios (aIRR) between empirical observations and matched modelled estimates and age-specific incidence over time from population-representative studies. Results: 3,508 empirical HIV incidence measurements (176 studies, 25 countries) were included. In 2014 [median study year], measurements from nationally-representative household surveys (aIRR 1.12 95%CrI 0.76, 1.65) and population-representative studies (aIRR 1.06 95%CrI 0.59, 1.91) were not significantly different from matched estimates, and declined at a similar rate (aIRR per five calendar years 1.04 95%CrI 0.94, 1.16). In 2014, empirical incidence among men was significantly lower and declined faster than in matched modelled estimates (aIRR 0.88 95%CrI 0.82, 0.94; aIRR per five calendar years 0.89 95%CrI 0.85, 0.93). Across population-based cohorts in Eastern and Southern Africa, adult HIV incidence declined by a median of 70% since 2010, and declined 4% faster per year (95%CrI 1, 6%) among young adults 15-24 years than 25-49 years, which was not captured by modelled estimates. Studies among pregnant women (aIRR 2.30 95%CrI 1.47, 3.61), control arms of clinical trials (aIRR 2.68 95%CrI 1.70, 4.20) and key populations (female sex workers aIRR 6.06 95%CrI 4.07, 9.03; men who have sex with men aIRR 44.07 95%CrI 28.43, 68.15) had significantly higher incidence. Conclusion: HIV incidence in sub-Saharan Africa has declined steeply in population-representative studies, similar to estimated trends. Response strategies should adapt to the ageing pattern of new infections indicated by population-representative cohorts in Eastern and Southern Africa. Populations recruited for HIV prevention/vaccine efficacy trials, pregnant women, and key populations are priority groups to reach with HIV prevention.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：据估计，撒哈拉以南非洲的HIV发病率自2000年以来已大幅下降。我们评估了估计的发病率水平、趋势和模式是否与实证观察结果一致。方法：我们更新了一项关于撒哈拉以南非洲成人HIV发病率数据的系统综述，纳入了2019至2024年发表的数据。我们将1990至2023年的实证发病率测量值与UNAIDS建模的HIV发病率估计值按研究地区、性别、年龄组和年份进行匹配。我们使用贝叶斯混合效应泊松回归来估计实证观察值与匹配的建模估计值之间的调整发病率比（aIRR），以及来自人群代表性研究的随时间变化的年龄别发病率。结果：共纳入3,508项实证HIV发病率测量值（176项研究，25个国家）。在2014年［研究中位年份］，来自全国代表性家庭调查的测量值（aIRR 1.12，95%CrI 0.76，1.65）和人群代表性研究的测量值（aIRR 1.06，95%CrI 0.59，1.91）与匹配估计值无显著差异，且以相似速率下降（每五个日历年的aIRR为1.04，95%CrI 0.94，1.16）。2014年，男性的实证发病率显著低于匹配的建模估计值，且下降更快（aIRR 0.88，95%CrI 0.82，0.94；每五个日历年的aIRR为0.89，95%CrI 0.85，0.93）。在东部和南部非洲的基于人群的队列中，成人HIV发病率自2010年以来中位下降70%，且15-24岁年轻成人的年下降速度比25-49岁人群快4%（95%CrI 1，6%），而建模估计值未捕捉到这一现象。孕妇研究（aIRR 2.30，95%CrI 1.47，3.61）、临床试验对照组（aIRR 2.68，95%CrI 1.70，4.20）和重点人群（女性性工作者aIRR 6.06，95%CrI 4.07，9.03；男男性行为者aIRR 44.07，95%CrI 28.43，68.15）的发病率显著更高。结论：在人群代表性研究中，撒哈拉以南非洲的HIV发病率已急剧下降，与估计趋势相似。应对策略应适应东部和南部非洲人群代表性队列所指示的新发感染的年龄模式。HIV预防/疫苗效力试验招募的人群、孕妇和重点人群是HIV预防应优先覆盖的群体。
